<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Doebner Modification (conversion of an aromatic aldehyde and malonic acid to an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid). The target product is likely cinnamic acid (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1). I will search the template catalog for templates that break an aldehyde and a carboxylic acid, form a C=C bond, and break C‑C and C‑O bonds.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehyde", "carboxylic_acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
